transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm, um... I'm here because of my job. I clean buildings, and... well, the thought of seeing a rat has gotten really bad. I can't do parts of my job anymore. Even when I know it's just an old building or, you know, a trash room, and it's probably not really dangerous. It's just... I can't.
Do you ever have episodes where you feel an intense fear or discomfort that reaches a peak within minutes?
I don't... I'm not sure what you mean. No, I don't think so. I just... I just get really tense if I have to go near the trash rooms. That's all.
Is your fear specifically of seeing rats, or is it also of other things you might encounter in your work?

It's just the rats. I mean... I already told you, it's just the thought of seeing a rat. It's gotten so bad I can't do my job. Even when I know a trash room isn't really dangerous, I just... I can't. It's just the rats.
Has your fear of seeing rats affected any parts of your life outside of work?

Um, outside of work? Not really, I guess. It's mostly just... well, at work. I've had to say no to cleaning some of the buildings. Or put it off. My boss is... he's starting to ask if I can even handle the regular routes anymore. I just... I don't want to lose my shifts, or miss out on being a lead cleaner because of this. But outside of that, no.
Do you think your fear of rats is unreasonable?

I guess so. I mean... yeah. Like I said, I know it's probably just an old building, or a regular trash room... I know it's not really dangerous. But I'm here because... the thought of seeing one has just gotten so bad that I can't do parts of my cleaning job anymore. Even knowing it's fine, I just... I can't.
Do you make an effort to avoid thinking about rats or being in situations where you might see one?

Yeah... I try to. If I can, I just... turn down the routes that have basements or storage rooms. Laundry areas, too. Or the dumpsters out in the alley. I just try to avoid them. 

And if I'm forced to clean one of those areas... I always keep the door propped open. I just rush through it as fast as I can. I'm pretty much just... scared the whole time I'm in there.
How long have you been afraid of seeing rats?
Um... about two years, I guess. It started when I moved into this older apartment building... people there just kept talking about rats. So... since then.
Has your fear of rats caused problems in your relationships with family or friends?
No... not really. I mean, I don't talk about it much with anyone. So... it doesn't really come up with my family or friends.
Has your fear of rats affected your overall well-being or daily life in any significant way?

Well... yeah, I guess it has. At work, mostly. I've... I've had to say no to some cleaning assignments, or put them off if they're in certain buildings. My supervisor... he's noticed. He started asking if I can actually handle my regular routes. I just... I don't know. I'm worried it's going to mess up my chances of getting better shifts... or maybe even moving up to a lead position.
Is your fear of rats because of what they are or because of what they might do to you?
I... I'm not really sure. I haven't thought about it like that. I just... I just don't like them. I don't know.
Has your fear of rats affected your ability to enjoy or participate in any social activities or hobbies you once liked?
No, not really. I don't... I don't go out much anyway. Just to work and back, mostly. So... it hasn't really changed anything like that.
Is your fear of rats because you're afraid of what might happen if you see one, like being bitten, or is it just the presence of the rat itself that scares you?
I... I don't know. Like I said, I just... I just can't be around them. I don't really know why.
Is it the rat itself that scares you, or is it the situation or place where you might see a rat that scares you?
I don't... I don't really know. It's just... I just don't want to be anywhere near them. That's all.
Is it the thought of the rat being in a specific place, like a dirty or dark area, that scares you, or is it just the rat itself, regardless of where it is?
It's... just the rat. It doesn't matter where it is. I just... I can't look at them.
Is it possible for you to imagine a rat in a completely clean and safe environment, like a zoo, without feeling afraid?
No... I can't. Even in a place like that, it's... it's still a rat. I just really don't want to think about it.
Are you afraid of any other animals besides rats?
No... just them. I don't... I don't really have a problem with anything else. Just... just them.
Are there any other specific animals or creatures that you find yourself fearing or avoiding, even if it's not as strong as your fear of rats?
No. Just... just the rats. Nothing else.
Is it possible for you to be in a situation where you know there are no rats, but still feel anxious because you're in a place where rats are often found?
I don't... I'm not really sure. I haven't really thought about it like that. I just... I try to stay away from those kinds of places to begin with.
Is it possible for you to be in a place where you might see a rat, but not actually see one, and still feel afraid?
I don't know. Like I said... I just try not to be in places like that at all. So I couldn't really tell you.
